evidence.ACL: Interstitial hyperintense signal of ACL, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.MCL: High signal in the soft tissue medial to the medial collateral ligament with mild increased signal intensity of proximal ligament, suspect grade 2 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: No evidence of tear noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: No evidence of tear noted in either medial or lateral meniscus in this study.
evidence.Effusion: Some joint effusion of right knee
evidence.Synovitis: mild hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema in bilateral femoral condyles and anteromedial and posterolateral aspect of proximal tibia, suspect bone contusion.
